readMe.a: Case Field Health & Tech Debt Analysis — SBU

readMe.b: Identify which Case fields are genuinely in use and which are tech debt, using measured record-level population rather than estimates.

Live Salesforce metadata (describe, FieldDefinition, Tooling CustomField and MetadataComponentDependency) read directly from SBU production (posnation.my.salesforce.com) on 2026-10-25. No intermediate metadata export.

Not required. Created Date, Created By, Last Modified and the reference counts (flows, formula fields, page layouts, other references) now come from the live read, replacing the August source catalogue used in September. Required? / Help Text / Description also come from the live read. Required? = the field is not nillable. Created Date is the UTC date on the CustomField record; the Shipping_Address sub-fields take the compound parent's.
Live SOQL aggregates against SBU production (org 00D40000000N194EAC, POS Nation) on 2026-10-25. No record export. Every measure is an exact count over every Case, not a sample.
2017-08-30 to 2026-10-25 (110 complete months plus 25 days of October 2026)

511 of 524 live Case fields assessed. The 13 Long Text Area fields (including the standard Internal Comments field) cannot be filtered or aggregated in SOQL and are listed on Not Assessable. The 8 Shipping_Address compound sub-fields ARE assessed. Id and the Shipping_Address__c compound parent are excluded as non-data fields. Since September, 31 Case fields have been deleted from the org and 4 added. See CHANGES SINCE THE SEPTEMBER MEASUREMENT below.

Column "Age (days)", from the field's live Created Date. 46 fields (the standard fields) have no creation date and show blank. The Shipping_Address sub-fields now carry the parent's creation date, which September left blank.
Column "% Populated (all records)" — measured across all 673,732 Cases, not sampled.

Columns "Eligible Records (since creation)" and "% Populated Since Creation" restrict the denominator to Cases created in or after the month the field was created. This is the fair measure: a field created in 2026 is not penalised for empty 2018 records.

"Adoption Lag (days)" is the gap between a field being created and the end of its first month of real use (>=1% of that month's Cases). A long lag means the field sat unused after it was built; 32 fields waited over a year.
29 field(s) predate the first Case in the org and are measured across the whole window. Flagged in "Created Before Export Window".

113 fields are formulas or roll-up summaries. They compute a value on every record, so population, recency and trend are meaningless for them. Those three components score "n/a" and the total renormalises over information content, integration and documentation.

75 checkbox fields. A checkbox is populated on 100% of records by definition, so every measure here uses % TRUE instead — including recency and trend, which required a separate pass over the records for TRUE values.

readMe.a: 4. New fields sit outside the score ladder
readMe.b: Fields under the grace period are banded "Too New - Provisional" rather than given a Healthy/Retire rating, because two components are structurally biased against them: Trend compares a 90-day window that predates the field, and Integration/Documentation lag behind field creation. Their score still shows, but as advisory only. Fields are also banded Provisional if they have too few eligible records to measure, whatever their age.

One column carries provenance: Custom (460), Standard (46) or Managed Package (5). Managed-package fields belong to an installed app (ringdna, AVA_SFCLOUD) and cannot be deleted at all, so they are excluded from Retire Candidates.

Weights, thresholds and bands are carried over unchanged from the XBU August workbook so both business units score on the same scale. Every weight and threshold on the Scoring Model tab is a live input — edit it and this workbook recalculates.

Columns "Source Records Populated" and "Variance vs Source" now compare the live count with the previous SBU measurement (Records Populated on the 2026-09-01 workbook). The two reads are 54 days apart, so a positive variance is new Cases. Variance vs Source is now a live formula (Records Populated minus Source). 507 fields carry a September figure: 310 rose, 166 are unchanged and 31 fell; the falls point to data cleanup or records being cleared (largest: Issue__c, -747). The median change is +85. The 4 fields added since September show blank.
IsDeleted was not used to filter; the SOQL baseline excludes soft-deleted records by default.

Distinct values come from SOQL COUNT_DISTINCT over every Case. Checkboxes show 1 when the box is ever TRUE and 0 when it never is. The 7 multi-select picklists do not support COUNT_DISTINCT, so their distinct values were counted exactly by reading every populated record. Time_Created__c (a Time formula) cannot be aggregated and is credited at the full-credit threshold. A distinct count of 0 (42 fields) means the field is never populated.

The record measures cannot see external integrations. Reference counts now come from a live dependency crawl (MetadataComponentDependency), which also returns Report and Email Template references (counted under Other Refs) but cannot see dashboards, list views or integration users. Standard fields are not covered by the dependency API and show 0 references. A field can look dead here and still break something on deletion.

"% Populated Last 90d" is the three most recent complete months (2026-07 to 2026-09) and "% Populated Last 365d" the twelve most recent complete months (2025-10 to 2026-09). Month-aligned windows keep the numerator and denominator consistent; the 25 days of October 2026 are excluded from both.
Every weight and threshold is an editable input (blue text, yellow fill). Change them and Field Health recalculates.
One row per assessed field: raw measures on the left, scored components and classification on the right.

The 134 fields seeded in September (from the source catalogue's "Deletion Candidates" and "Deletable Custom Fields" tabs, plus every retire candidate then), with verdicts refreshed, plus 4 new retire candidates. 21 seeded fields have since been deleted and are marked "Deleted from org". Add your own notes in the Notes column.
Custom, non-required fields past the grace period with no measurable current value (112 fields, down from 127). Sorted by Total References, then Health Score.
Custom formula fields with no metadata references, or a single constant value.
Required fields not actually populated, fields adopted more than a year after creation, and fields with no help text or description.
A low score is a prompt to investigate, not an instruction to delete. Verify dependencies before removing any field.

"Effective Age (days)" (column AT) is now a live formula: the days between the Analysis as-of date (Scoring Model tab) and the older of the field's creation month and its first month carrying data. Formula and roll-up fields keep their metadata age, because they compute retroactively and would otherwise all look ancient; never-populated fields anchor to their creation month. It is reference information only: backfilled data can make a genuinely new field look years old, so the Band, Trend, Classification and Action formulas key the grace period on the literal "Age (days)" from the metadata Created Date. A field created within the grace period is always "Too New - Provisional" and can never be a retire candidate. The cost is that a deleted-and-redeployed long-standing field is parked provisional for one grace period — the safe direction of error.

Re-measured from scratch against live SBU production on 2026-10-25, replacing the 2026-09-01 read; the tab structure, columns, Scoring Model inputs and every scored formula are unchanged. 31 Case fields were deleted from SBU production between 2026-09-01 and 2026-10-25: 21 September retire candidates (including Payments_Portal_ID__c, Peripheral_5__c, Peripheral_6__c, Trainsact__c and Worldpay_Approval__c, which the sfa team had highlighted as deleted in the Full Sandbox) plus Case_Creator_Role_del__c, Consumer_Affairs_Eligible__c, Credit_Card_Integration__c, Equipment_Received__c, Exclude_from_In_House_Commission__c, GuideCX_Project__c, HPS_Welcome_Package__c, Inventory_Import_2__c, Moving_Server__c and New_TID__c. 4 fields were added: New_Processor__c, Original_Processor__c, Primary_Incident__c and Projected_Churn_Date__c. 106 September retire candidates remain in the org. The yellow highlights (sfa Team Notes) are carried over by field name; the 6 still in production remain highlighted.

Re-run the same live reads against SBU production (sf CLI alias sbuprod): describe + Tooling CustomField + MetadataComponentDependency for metadata; per-month SOQL COUNT aggregates batched 40 fields per query; a separate % TRUE pass per checkbox; exact COUNT_DISTINCT for cardinality; and month-aligned 90d/365d windows. Then set the Analysis as-of date on the Scoring Model tab.

Grace-period defect corrected: the "Too New" check previously read Effective Age, which backfilled data inflates, so fields created in mid-2026 (e.g. within the last 90 days) could be classed Retire candidate or Review. The check now reads actual Age (days). Classification and Action are now live formulas (with two new tunable thresholds on the Scoring Model tab) instead of static text, so they recalculate together with the scores. Retire Candidates and Verify Formula Usage exclude all fields inside the grace period.
